source.english_context: Unit 05 Money, Banking, and Payments Goal: pay safely, understand bank words, and avoid common money mistakes. Daily Life English I would like to open a checking account. Do you accept cash? Can I pay by card? I think this charge is wrong. Where is the nearest ATM? I would like to withdraw twenty dollars. Can I deposit this check? What is my current balance? Is there a monthly fee for this account? My card was declined. I would like to report a lost card. How do I change my PIN? Can you explain this bank statement? How long will this transfer take? Could I have a receipt, please? Vocabulary checking account a bank account for daily spending debit card a card that uses money from your account credit card a card that lets you borrow and pay later fee extra money you must pay receipt proof that you paid scam a dishonest trick to take money ATM a machine where you can take out money using a bank card balance the amount of money in an account withdraw take money out of an account deposit put money into an account bank statement a record of money going into and out of an account PIN a secret number used with a bank card or account US Customs Keep receipts for returns, rent, deposits, and large payments. Never pay a stranger with gift cards, crypto, or wire transfer for an emergency call. Ask about monthly fees, ATM fees, minimum balances, and overdraft fees. Dialogue Student: I want to open a checking account. Banker: Do you have an ID and proof of address? Student: Yes. I have my passport and lease. Banker: Great. Do you want a debit card? Student: Yes, please. Are there monthly fees?

japanese_explanation.heading: お金の安全を守る
points: 銀行口座、デビットカード、クレジットカードは便利ですが、手数料を確認しましょう。特に毎月の手数料、ATM手数料、残高不足の手数料です。
電話やメッセージで、ギフトカード、暗号資産、送金アプリで急に払えと言われたら詐欺を疑います。
家賃、保証金、大きな買い物は必ずレシートや確認メールを残してください。

existing_simplified_chinese.heading: 保护自己的钱
points: 银行账户、借记卡和信用卡很方便，但要确认费用，特别是月费、ATM费和透支费。
如果有人打电话或发信息，让你马上用礼品卡、加密货币或转账软件付款，要警惕诈骗。
房租、押金和大额购物一定要保存收据或确认邮件。

ja.heading: お金の安全を守る
points: 銀行口座、デビットカード、クレジットカードは便利ですが、手数料を確認しましょう。特に毎月の手数料、ATM手数料、残高不足の手数料です。
電話やメッセージで、ギフトカード、暗号資産、送金アプリで急に払えと言われたら詐欺を疑います。
家賃、保証金、大きな買い物は必ずレシートや確認メールを残してください。

ko.heading: 돈을 안전하게 지키세요
points: 은행 계좌, 직불 카드, 신용 카드는 편리하지만, 수수료를 꼭 확인하세요. 특히 월별 수수료, ATM 수수료, 잔액 부족 수수료를 주의하세요.
전화나 메시지로 기프트 카드, 암호화폐, 송금 앱으로 즉시 결제하라는 요청을 받으면 사기를 의심하세요.
월세, 보증금, 큰 금액의 구매에 대해서는 반드시 영수증이나 확인 이메일을 보관하세요.

zh-Hans.heading: 保护您的钱财安全
points: 银行账户、借记卡和信用卡很方便，但请务必确认费用。特别是月费、ATM费和透支费。
如果有人通过电话或信息，要求您立即使用礼品卡、加密货币或转账应用付款，请警惕诈骗。
对于租金、押金和大额购物，请务必保留收据或确认邮件。

es.heading: Proteja su dinero
points: Las cuentas bancarias, tarjetas de débito y tarjetas de crédito son convenientes, pero asegúrese de verificar las tarifas. Especialmente las tarifas mensuales, las tarifas de cajero automático y las tarifas por sobregiro o saldo insuficiente.
Si alguien le pide repentinamente que pague con tarjetas de regalo, criptomonedas o aplicaciones de transferencia de dinero por teléfono o mensaje, sospeche de una estafa.
Para el alquiler, depósitos y compras grandes, siempre guarde los recibos o correos electrónicos de confirmación.

pt-BR.heading: Proteja seu dinheiro
points: Contas bancárias, cartões de débito e cartões de crédito são convenientes, mas verifique as taxas. Especialmente as taxas mensais, taxas de caixa eletrônico e taxas por saldo insuficiente.
Se alguém pedir de repente que você pague com cartões de presente, criptomoedas ou aplicativos de transferência de dinheiro por telefone ou mensagem, desconfie de um golpe.
Para aluguel, depósitos e compras grandes, sempre guarde os recibos ou e-mails de confirmação.

fr.heading: Protégez votre argent
points: Les comptes bancaires, les cartes de débit et les cartes de crédit sont pratiques, mais vérifiez toujours les frais. En particulier les frais mensuels, les frais de guichet automatique et les frais pour solde insuffisant (découvert).
Si l'on vous demande subitement de payer par carte-cadeau, cryptomonnaie ou application de transfert d'argent par téléphone ou message, méfiez-vous d'une arnaque.
Pour les loyers, les dépôts de garantie et les achats importants, conservez toujours les reçus ou les e-mails de confirmation.

de.heading: Schützen Sie Ihr Geld
points: Bankkonten, Debitkarten und Kreditkarten sind praktisch, aber prüfen Sie unbedingt die Gebühren. Insbesondere monatliche Gebühren, Geldautomaten-Gebühren und Gebühren für unzureichende Deckung.
Wenn Sie per Telefon oder Nachricht plötzlich aufgefordert werden, mit Geschenkkarten, Kryptowährung oder einer Überweisungs-App zu bezahlen, sollten Sie Betrug vermuten.
Bewahren Sie bei Mietzahlungen, Kautionen und großen Einkäufen immer Quittungen oder Bestätigungs-E-Mails auf.
